class.name: ResonanceRuntime
class.brief_description: Native runtime orchestrator for Nexus Resonance.
class.description: Runtime node that initializes [ResonanceServer], applies a [url=#ResonanceRuntimeConfig]ResonanceRuntimeConfig[/url], drives the listener-centric Steam Audio tick, and owns the optional debug overlays. Engine init uses [method get_config_dict]. Bus wiring, the reverb activator and the FMOD/Coda bridges are GDScript helpers driven from this node. Use one ResonanceRuntime per running game.

method.name: apply_bus_to_players
method.description: Re-applies the effective bus routing to all [ResonancePlayer] nodes that follow the global default. Call after changing bus names on the [member runtime] config at runtime.

method.name: get_bus_effective
method.description: Effective Godot bus for the direct and pathing (player) output. Falls back to Master when the config has no bus set.

method.name: get_coda_bridge
method.description: Returns the active Coda bridge helper, or null when [member coda_bridge_enabled] is off or no Coda autoload was found at init.

method.name: get_config_dict
method.description: Returns the config dict passed to [method ResonanceServer.init_audio_engine]: [method ResonanceRuntimeConfig.get_config] merged with runtime-only fields ([member context_simd_level], [member context_validation], and the player-ray [code]debug_occlusion[/code] flag).

method.name: get_fmod_bridge
method.description: Returns the active FMOD bridge helper, or null when [member fmod_bridge_enabled] is off. [ResonanceFmodEventEmitter] nodes use this to feed Steam Audio.

method.name: get_frame_timings
method.description: Per-frame timing snapshot of the main-thread tick (last tick, activator and reinit microseconds). Detailed per-phase entries are only filled when [member performance_custom_monitors] is Full.

method.name: get_reverb_bus_name
method.description: Effective bus name that hosts the reverb effect and the activator. Falls back to ResonanceReverb when the config has no name set.

method.name: get_reverb_bus_send
method.description: Target bus the reverb bus sends to (same as [method get_bus_effective]).

method.name: refresh_player_bus_routing
method.description: Recomputes and re-applies bus routing for the reverb bus and all players. Call after changing bus configuration at runtime.

method.name: request_static_scene_reload
method.description: Queues a deferred reload of all [ResonanceStaticScene] geometry under this node into the server. Use after changing static geometry at runtime.

members.member: [url=#ResonanceRuntimeConfig]ResonanceRuntimeConfig[/url] resource for Steam Audio simulation and Godot bus names. Engine init reads it through [method get_config_dict]. If empty, a default config is created at runtime.
Creates the FMOD bridge helper at init so [ResonanceFmodEventEmitter] nodes can feed Steam Audio. Requires the FMOD Godot integration; see docs/FMOD_BRIDGE.md.
Creates the Coda bridge helper at init so [ResonanceCodaEventEmitter] nodes sync spatial audio. Requires a CodaRuntime autoload named Coda.

SIMD instruction set for the Steam Audio context: Default, AVX-512, AVX2, AVX, SSE4 or SSE2. Default (-1) lets Steam Audio pick the best level for the CPU. Changing after init may require restarting the audio engine.
Enables Steam Audio API validation in the context. For debugging API misuse only; adds overhead. Changing after init may require restarting the audio engine.
Master switch for the runtime debug overlays. When true, the overlay toggle keys work at runtime; when false, keys are ignored and any active overlay is hidden. Keys are always ignored in the editor.
Key that toggles the debug overlay (server status, log) while [member enable_debug] is true. Default F1.
Key that toggles the performance overlay (FPS, frame time) while [member enable_debug] is true. Default F2.
Key that toggles the player overlay (source/occlusion and reflection rays) while [member enable_debug] is true. Default F3.

Custom Performance monitors registered in the Godot debugger: Off, Core, Standard (default) or Full. Full also enables the per-phase frame timings in [method get_frame_timings]. Applies while the game runs; the overlays still require [member enable_debug].
